authority_resolution.method: AMD-0005 scoped resolution using current mirrored authority, frozen Backend009 preparation, actual shared source and current UI-role readback. No authority or decision is created by this proposal.

resolved.conclusion: Identity owns recovery-code sets, individual single-use state and safe operation lineage. Persist only verifier-safe code representations; no retrievable recovery-code escrow in application tokens, vault, encrypted operation payload, outbox, logs or QA evidence.

Generate/Replace requires fresh authorized shared step-up bound to exact caller, session, origin, operation, correlation, scope/resource, expected version and canonical context. Resolve effective policy at execution and final owner commit.

Recovery-code consumption is fallback evidence inside a trusted recovery-owner operation. Do not implicitly demand an already-held password/strong-factor session, expose a generic public validity oracle, grant a session, reset another factor, or complete recovery. P2-011 owns precedence and explicit RecoveryResult effects.

resolved.basis: P2-009 criterion2; Catalog32 section2; existing owner transaction/outbox seams
resolved.conclusion: One individual claim, its exact dependent owner effect and safe outbox share transactional finality. Failed owner application rolls the claim back. Stable operation identity reconciles duplicates/uncertainty without another generation, consumption or secret disclosure.

resolved.basis: FRD17 sections6/13/15; current UI lean comparison and FigJam readback
resolved.conclusion: One-time disclosure/download does not authorize a server read-again or silent replacement after loss. Approved baseline reveal exists. Detailed combined reveal/local requested-download admission and replacement/loss feedback remain explicit refinements, not an invented missing-design declaration.

resolved.basis: Doc06 sections4/5; Doc08 sections10/11; FRD17 sections14/15; Doc28 audit/support boundaries
resolved.conclusion: Recovery values are restricted authentication material. Safe events/status contain references and minimum metadata. Admin/Support cannot recover values. No raw request, exception, assertion diff, diagnostic capture, URL or evidence may carry them.

Inventory new verifier/set/operation/delivery metadata and explicit owner cleanup/hold behavior. Production requires approved scoped inputs. Consumed, invalidated or expired is not physically erased; no retention duration, legal basis or production activation is selected here.
Preserve universal Account identity and explicit capability policy. No new adult-only recovery rule, duplicate child identity or inferred commercial entitlement.

reuse_seams.scope: ExecuteOutcomeAsync validates exact binding, invokes the owner within the transaction, rechecks current source/session/policy after awaited work, rolls back owner conflicts/stale authority and consumes proof with outbox at commit. Recovery issue/replace should reuse this seam, not a parallel proof manager.
Framework verifier mechanics and bounded work illustrate reuse. Its six-digit canonicalization, clock/replay horizon and purpose are TOTP-specific and must not be copied into recovery policy.
Audit all native store registrations/call sites so a recovery convenience API cannot silently reach the raw RecoveryCodes token path.
Use Identity-owned set/generation, per-code verifier, exact operation and transactional outbox state. No new service, generic credential repository or plaintext seed-store adaptation is justified.

Current context sets acceptDownloads:false. Current contract scanner requires non-profile artifact/download roots empty. A recovery requested download is outside that registered contract; no existing TOTP privacy PASS proves it.

native_default_constraints: Frozen primary R&D identifies UserStoreBase recovery replacement/redemption as a redeemable-string token path, incompatible with AUTH-01 when used unchanged.

Framework PasswordHasher is a candidate for salted verifier mechanics; its user parameter alone does not establish owner/set/purpose binding. Review explicit unambiguous context binding and test it with the same test code across distinct contexts.

Fresh primary-source follow-up identifies default generator entropy as unsuitable for the reviewed saved-recovery profile; see primary-source-followup.json. Do not treat frozen-v1 generator reuse as selected or approved.

The framework convenience generation API passes distinct values to storage but returns its original list. A candidate must prove exact unique returned/stored cardinality under forced collisions rather than infer it from the API name.

typed_sketch_cross_review.finding: No unsafe business default or public validation oracle selected. Internal consume context, provisional claim, verifier-only ledger and one winning post-commit first-delivery constraints align with this review.
technical_refinements: Require the actual active same-owner transaction; reject an absent or mismatched transaction and recheck trusted case/policy/set authority after awaited verification at final commit.
Define lifecycle-version versus per-code usage/version semantics explicitly so different-code concurrency follows the selected owner policy.
Require the effective runtime profile to match current server origin/scope/operation, not merely an effective time or caller-provided profile reference.

Existing CompleteBrowserAsync returns Task and ProofCompleted emits fixed JSON. A narrowly reviewed owner response projection must carry transient delivery only in the winning current request after confirmed commit; no singleton/scoped cross-request cache, later GET or generic result hook that rediscloses values.

current_ui_alignment.scope: Contingent admission and public inert accessibility illustration only; no live file or additional display/download grant. Requested is not saved; loss stays nondisclosing. Exact approved existing reveal is retained.

threats_and_required_controls.control: Only salted supported verifiers plus classified minimum metadata; no plaintext/encrypted reversible fallback. Integration tests inspect actual writes, native token rows and safe outbox projections.
Explicit purpose/owner/set-generation binding, exact trusted operation context, current version and one transactional winner; same-operation retry returns safe lineage only.

threats_and_required_controls.threat: Consume/replace race or stale proof commits after source change
threats_and_required_controls.control: Existing owner/session lock ordering and final authority revalidation; PostgreSQL concurrency and rollback proof with barriers around hash/owner awaits. Replacement timing follows the selected owner contract.

threats_and_required_controls.threat: Hash amplification, unbounded per-set scan or account enumeration
threats_and_required_controls.control: Explicit validated finite profile, count/input/work limits and applicable authoritative throttling. No unbounded hash loop, lower-cost silent fallback or public code-validation oracle.

threats_and_required_controls.threat: Lost response causes regeneration or second disclosure
threats_and_required_controls.control: Stable generation/operation identity; preselected single-delivery admission; metadata-only recovery. Preserve UNKNOWN when commit or delivery cannot be proved.

threats_and_required_controls.threat: Download exemption becomes general secret capture
threats_and_required_controls.control: Separate literal recovery registration, one armed request and exact owned-file identity; inspect bytes only inside protected child; reject any other file/download/capture; verify removal and process/surface cleanup.

owner_inputs_to_refine.needed: Concrete generator/encoding/canonicalization with entropy accounting, unique set cardinality, finite input/count/hash-work/resource limits and version compatibility.
owner_inputs_to_refine.owner_boundary: Identity/Security technical contract within existing authority; no production format/count/work value selected by this review.

owner_inputs_to_refine.needed: Versioned effective assurance/method mapping, proof lifetime, policy selection and source/currentness checks.
owner_inputs_to_refine.owner_boundary: Existing Identity assurance owner and P2-019 approved runtime inputs; no TOTP assurance copied by default.

owner_inputs_to_refine.needed: Exact expected-set version, when old codes stop being valid, handling of delivery loss/UNKNOWN and explicitly selected effects.
owner_inputs_to_refine.owner_boundary: Identity contract refinement; no automatic revoke-all, coexistence or deferred activation invented.

owner_inputs_to_refine.needed: Whether the same held transient disclosure permits one explicitly requested local download; exact request admission, disposal and loss semantics; scoped visual/feedback consent where material.
owner_inputs_to_refine.owner_boundary: Identity owns authorization/delivery, UI implements approved presentation; baseline reveal is already designed. No additional grant is inferred from an inert picture.

owner_inputs_to_refine.needed: Explicit handling of after-use replacement and notification obligations across issuance/consumption/recovery workflow.
owner_inputs_to_refine.owner_boundary: 009/011 Identity and016 notification contracts; do not silently auto-issue or claim conformance while unresolved.

owner_inputs_to_refine.needed: Inventory, scoped processing authority, retention trigger/action/holds, restore behavior and physical cleanup evidence.
owner_inputs_to_refine.owner_boundary: Identity owns lifecycle implementation,019 approved inputs,017 conformance. No global/legal duration or development stop inferred.

disposition: Security/QA refinement can proceed under existing authority. Implementation waits native eligibility and the specific typed/UI/private-download refinements. Proposed tests are not executed evidence; startup review is not final role, Product, production or release acceptance.
